title: Open Sesame
subtitle: A universal incantation and a useless defense.

trails.title: Late Warning
trails.description: Beware. The dangerous bird may still be at large.

content.text:
Name: Ludwig
Race: Arcanist
Characteristics: His head resembles that of a raven.
Arcane Skill: Ludwig can use language to influence people's thoughts. If you hear him use an imperative sentence directed at you, cover your ears immediately. Do not listen to him. You cannot realistically resist its effects unless you can think without using words.
Time of Disappearance: Officially confirmed missing during personnel checks after the ninth "Storm."

If you find Ludwig, or a raven that might be him, please contact the nearest chief-level personnel.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: What an absurd experience.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Using my eyes to gauge the distance, what I saw was a far-off tower and the many difficulties to reach it.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: That, I realize now, was another result of my "observation."

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Yet the moment I stop trying to logically deduce its location, lo and behold—here it is.
He touches the white wall before him, as if to confirm it's really there.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: If arcanists truly live in a world of such unpredictability as this, it's little wonder many think they have mental problems.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Alright. Since everything's been reset, that thieving raven will likely reappear at the tower with his shiny contraband in tow.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: The only problem is getting inside.
Where a door should be, there is only a wall.
Enigma tilts his head back and estimates the tower's height, weighing whether it's worth the climb.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: There aren't enough footholds. And I'm not certain whether that structure up there is in fact a window.
He pauses, then lowers his voice.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Open sesame.
The wall doesn't answer, nor does it mock him for trying.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Arcanists can't just make up incantations, it seems. I thought as much.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Surely I don't have to delve into my imagination.
He closes his eyes, still facing the stubborn wall.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Arcane skills. Arcane skills! How on earth do they figure out these things?!

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: I should've asked for a copy of A Basic Guide to Using Arcanum before cutting off communications!

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Never mind. The principles ought to be about the same. Focus your mind and let the intensity of your thoughts bore a hole in the wall.
Not hoping to turn your thoughts into a sledgehammer, are you?
Enigma's eyes snap open. The unchanging darkness is gone.
He follows the sound upward. The raven glides down for a smooth landing.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: I never expected the ever-logical Adler would have such a wild imagination.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Enough wasting time. Hand it over.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: You didn't make all that effort making your way here simply to rob me, did you? Hm, seems Laplace hasn't been so busy these days.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: As you can see, your instincts have interfered with our work.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: If you enjoy collecting shiny things so much, I'll give you this communicator. Take it, or any other thing you want.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: Empirical judgments, overly confident speculations. Yes, that's the way you think.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: And why you'll never comprehend the use of arcane skills.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: That's irrelevant.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Has the simulation been upgraded, or are you being affected by corrupted data?

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: The others haven't shared much personal information on "Ludwig." Are you German?

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: Ludwig just mechanically turns his head and fixes his gaze on him.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: I understand what you want exactly.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: You've come to this tower many times, seeking to destroy it and this farce of an experiment.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: Then, something changed. You became curious—wanted to uncover its secrets. The natural instinct of a researcher.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: But you turned far too hasty in your pursuit, even starting to explore matters you could never hope to understand.
A constant stream of words flows from Ludwig's beak.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Enough chit-chat. You ...

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: Du   kannst   das   Arkanum   nicht   begreifen.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Stop!
He finally understands the source of his discomfort.
He has never sensed arcane fluctuations before. Not until now.
Of course, he can't immediately detect the abnormalities quietly building around him.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: Darum   kannst   du   diese   Tür   nicht   öffnen.
Enigma grabs the communicator and throws it at the raven, who effortlessly dodges with a flap of his wings.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: You're the one interfering with my experiment, Researcher Adler. I need the core to help me unveil the mysteries of language.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: In fact, not long ago, I made a rather decent discovery.
Another flap of black wings. Enigma notices data flowing across them.
Their silhouette begins to melt away, giving way to the cold gleam of metal beneath.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Was that hypnosis? A curse? Or a prophecy?

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: All that nonsense, and yet nothing has come of it. Most likely needs time to activate.
Enigma checks his timer.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: There's still half an hour left. Enough time to get you out of my way.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: I need the core. It stays here.
The fortress crumbles. The metal dissolves like foam. Ludwig twitches on the ground.
He spreads his wings and struggles into an upright position. Data flashes in his black eyes.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: My data. You've utterly destroyed it.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: We both know the box will reset. And you'll go back to your chattering, Raven.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: Ah, yes. The pieces exist in a world that may be reset. One might think their lives are full of opportunity and that everything is recoverable.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: But under special conditions, these pieces can also "die."

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: What do you mean?

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: The core's contents have the ability to interfere with everything around it. It can tear your mind apart, even scramble your data into a jumbled mess.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: Opening its protective shell won't bring you the results you're looking for.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: Ludwig already paid the price for his curiosity. His experiment failed, and his mind was imprisoned here. It wasn't until a short while ago that he finally departed.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: I am merely a segment of leftover data. An attempt to warn other curious minds to stay well away from danger.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: You mean to say your actions came from good intentions?

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Care to explain that incantation of yours? It still hasn't taken effect.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: It was meant to change your mind—to prevent you from comprehending the arcane presence here. In stopping you from entering the tower, you would be protected from the madness and ruin that awaits.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: There's no need for you to go the way of the other pieces who came here, breaking down piece by piece until you eventually vanish into nothing.
His feathers begin to fall. More symbols flicker across his body.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: But you needn't worry. It won't be long until my arcane skill ceases to function.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: I've never had the opportunity to work with Ludwig. But based on your simulation of him, I can guess he's a stubborn, conceited, curious, egotistical fellow.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: Oh, not really. Just a raven cursed with knowledge trying his best to protect those who come after.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: *sigh* A typical Laplace employee.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: You're unhappy.
He studies Enigma with eyes that no longer shine.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: No. I was only thinking that perhaps there should be someone who helps bear the risks and make decisions on behalf of these geniuses.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Working alongside colleagues with no understanding of lab safety protocols comes at too great a price. Having a branch director go missing for so long must have certainly affected productivity.
Ludwig catches the anger in his words and the trace of grief beneath it. He tries to move past both.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: But you and I have never worked together.
Enigma checks his timer again.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: We've been colleagues for the last ten minutes.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: You're not going to heed my warning, are you? You're still going to remove the core—to satisfy your curiosity.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: I AM going to take it. Because I want Laplace to remain a place for people like you.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Someone has to do something.
Ludwig nods.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: What a coincidence. Some of the previous pieces who came here said a similar thing.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: Their data was also destroyed. Unless new data is uploaded, they'll never appear in the box again.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: I'm not entirely sure what to call it. I hope you'll forgive me for presuming it as "death."

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: Which, I believe, is precisely what I'm experiencing now.

items.speaker: Ludwig
items.text: Farewell, my colleague. I wish you all the best.
Ludwig vanishes into the air, and on the wall behind where he had stood, a door appears.

items.speaker: Enigma
items.text: Farewell.
Enigma approaches the door.
